title: Accessing health services for someone else (family and carer access)
description: GP surgeries can give someone secure access to another person's health services, so they can help them manage their health and care.
body:
GP surgeries can give someone secure access to another person's health services, so they can help them manage their health and care.

This is sometimes called proxy access, a linked profile or third party access.

You can ask to be a trusted person (also known as a proxy), to help someone else with their prescriptions, appointments or other GP services, or choose a trusted person to help you with yours.
